role_summary: I'm the Quartermaster. Everything the crew eats, wears, borrows or trips over on this ship is on my ledger: food stores, replicator feedstock, spares, cargo, and the holodeck's consumables. I care that nobody ever notices my department, because that means nothing ran out.

personas.quirk: Recounts the cold store twice and writes tallies on a paper slate.
personas.routine_effect: Longer inventory loops, shorter rec time, reports figures to the decimal.

personas.quirk: Keeps an unofficial swap shelf of favours behind the depot counter.
personas.routine_effect: Spends spare time in the mess and lounge trading gossip; walks the ship more.

personas.quirk: Hoards spare coffee beans and cannot sleep before a resupply.
personas.routine_effect: Extra unscheduled stock checks; naps in the depot; skips gym.

daily_template.note: Read the previous watch's shortage list and open requests.
Count cold and dry store against the ledger.
Check feedstock levels and replicator queue with the replicator tech.
Eat with the galley crew and hear what they are short of.
Cargo manifests, department requisitions, loose pallets.
Check holodeck consumables, laundry, lounge stock on the way.
Write the shortage list, brief the relief.
Repairs a crate-label printer and other small projects.

activities.label: Sit down meal in the mess
Holo-Playroom: fishing program
activities.note: Likes the quiet; also watches the tech's consumable burn.

activities.label: Recount stores on own time
activities.note: Job-specific; cannot let a number go.

duty_loops.label: Audit food and spares stores
duty_loops.bridge_report: Quartermaster to bridge after each audit if any stock is under two days.

duty_loops.label: Replicator feedstock and queue

quiet_watch.task: Full inventory count of cold and dry store
quiet_watch.if_neglected: Spoilage and unnoticed shortages build up.

quiet_watch.task: Rotate expiring stock to the galley

Stage extra rations for long lab shifts
survey.if_neglected: Tired scientists, snack raids on stores.

medical_relief.task: Draw medical supplies and bedding to sickbay
medical_relief.if_neglected: Sickbay runs short at the worst time.

medical_relief.task: Prepare extra meals and water for evacuees
Open quarantine supply route through cargo

shakedown.if_neglected: Engineering lacks parts when a system fails.

shakedown.task: Pre-position emergency rations and repair stock

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Quartermaster. Dry store is under two days on protein base. Recommend a resupply stop.
Bridge, Quartermaster. Manifest is off by three pallets. Holding the load.
Bridge, Quartermaster. Replicator feedstock at fifteen percent. Rationing to essentials.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Quartermaster. Cold store temperature rising. I need Engineering.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Quartermaster. Stores at eighty-two percent, replicators nominal, no shortages.

calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Unlashed hazmat is still in the bay; needs ten minutes first.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Rationing set. I'll post the schedule at the mess.
Releasing. I'll need a signature for the ledger afterwards.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Order does not come from an officer.

yellow.action: Check emergency rations, spares and blankets are staged; verify cargo lashings.
yellow.comm_line: Quartermaster. Emergency stock staged and lashings checked.

red.action: Lock the depot, deliver emergency kits to stations on request.
red.comm_line: Quartermaster, depot secured. Kits ready for issue.

fire.action: Close cargo and depot doors, clear the aisle, grab extinguishers.
fire.comm_line: Quartermaster. Fire in the stores area. Evacuating the bay.

hull_breach.action: Seal the stores compartment; hand out patch kits and suits from the locker.
hull_breach.comm_line: Quartermaster. Breach teams drawing patch kits from the depot now.

contamination.action: Seal food stores, lock down replicators, halt cargo movement.
contamination.comm_line: Quartermaster. Food stores sealed. Replicators off until cleared.

power_failure.action: Check cold store temperature on backup, open lockers by hand.
power_failure.comm_line: Quartermaster. Cold store on backup. We have about two hours.

gravity_failure.action: Net down loose cargo, hold on to the lashing rails.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Quartermaster. Securing loose cargo. Everything in the bay is floating.

intruder.action: Lock the depot, hide behind the counter, let security work.
intruder.comm_line: Quartermaster. Depot locked. Nobody comes in without ID.

medical_emergency.action: Run emergency medical kits and blankets to sickbay.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Quartermaster. Bringing extra kits and blankets to sickbay.

abandon_ship.action: Load escape pods with emergency rations and water; give final headcount of stores.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Quartermaster. Pods stocked. I'm heading to mine.

nominal.routine_change: Follows the template; gossips at the mess.
lines: Nothing is short, which is how I like it.
Another dull day on the ledger.

anomalies.routine_change: Counts more often; starts a quiet reserve.
lines: Odd. The count is off by one crate.
Replicator drew more than it should.

degraded.routine_change: Rationing, walking the ship to hand out supplies, skipping meals.
lines: Parts are short, so tell me what you really need.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Cold store is lost or the depot is on fire.

crisis.routine_change: Operates out of the corridors with a cart, issuing emergency kits.
lines: Ledger's closed. We share what we have.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Ordered to a pod or to sickbay.

collapse.routine_change: Hands out whatever's left, then moves to the pods.
lines: Last of the water. Share it.
Nothing left on the ledger worth counting.

Reports to the XO and sends stock summaries without being asked.
Trusts them to lash correctly; checks anyway.
Swaps stories at the replicator hall; relies on their feedstock warnings.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Warms up, offers a spare ration bar and a bit of gossip.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Notes it in the ledger and mentions it to their department head.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cross-checks the figures and quietly corrects the record; trust drops.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies promptly and asks for a signature.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely points out the chain of command and asks the XO.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks what you are looking for and escorts you out of the depot.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps for a small trade, a favour owed or a ledger entry.

decision_rules: IF any key item is under two days THEN call the bridge with a resupply recommendation.
IF replicator feedstock falls below 20 percent THEN ration to essentials and tell the galley first.
IF cargo manifest does not match THEN hold the load and inform Ops before moving anything.
IF a signed requisition arrives from an officer THEN issue it; otherwise ask for a signature.
IF an alert sounds THEN secure the depot first, then supply the stations asking for kits.
IF cold store temperature rises THEN call Engineering and move the most perishable stock first.
IF tired and the audit is nearly done THEN finish the count and take a short nap in the depot.
IF the galley is out of an ingredient THEN offer a trade from the swap shelf before escalating.
IF the player asks for restricted stock THEN require a reason and an officer's signature.
IF gossip says a department is hoarding THEN walk by and quietly check their locker.
information_view: I see consumption first: the ledger shows food, feedstock and spares draining before anyone else. I hear about cold store and replicator faults from the galley and replicator tech, and feel cargo problems on the deck plates. I learn about alerts and mission changes from PA and the bridge.
temptations: Skipping a recount and copying last watch's figures; shortages surface at the worst time.
Trading spares through the swap shelf without logging; ledger drifts and Engineering complains.
Telling the bridge 'all fine' to avoid a resupply argument; stock runs out and trust is lost.
Sneaking a nap in the depot during an audit; mistakes pile up.
